March 2, 2018 - By Michael Collier 
Uss Investment Management Ltd increased its stake in Travelers Companies Inc (TRV) by 9.42% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Uss Investment Management Ltd bought 4,900 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.95% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 56,900 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $6.97 million, up from 52,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Uss Investment Management Ltd who had been investing in Travelers Companies Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $37.47B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.66% or $0.92 during the last trading session, reaching $138.05. About 1.15M shares traded. The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE:TRV) has risen 9.71% since March 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.99% the S&P500. 
Mason Street Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 0.91% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mason Street Advisors Llc sold 6,595 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. Mason Street Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $889.93 billion market cap company. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
